scrapers.name: StreamAPI
scrapers.description: Thin client for a self-hosted strmprov aggregator server (see README) - queries multiple providers at once via HTTP and returns the combined results. Requires the server URL to be set in this provider's settings.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: Vidrock
scrapers.description: Vidrock multi-server streaming with AES-256-GCM decrypted sources
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: MovieBox
scrapers.description: MovieBox streaming via the H5 web API with multiple resolutions and subtitles
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: RiveStream
scrapers.description: RiveStream multi-server streaming (Citadel, PrimeVids and others) with subtitles
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: 4KHDHub
scrapers.description: 4KHDHub direct links
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: UHDMovies
scrapers.description: UHD Movies streaming with multiple resolution. Its "Instant Download" path terminates at a video-downloads.googleusercontent.com Google Drive link; this used to never support HTTP Range at all, but re-verified live (2026-09-17) that's no longer uniformly true - some of these links now return a genuine 206 with fast end-of-file seeks (needed for many MKVs' seek index), though roughly half still silently ignore Range and hand back the full multi-GB file with a 200. lib/aggregate.js's dropUnplayable now live-probes each Google Drive link's actual Range support and only keeps the ones that pass, instead of the previous blanket domain-based drop. The other path ("Resume Cloud") is still gated behind a real Cloudflare Turnstile challenge and isn't used.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: Vixsrc
scrapers.description: Vixsrc M3U8 streaming with auto quality selection
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: Vidlink
scrapers.description: Vidlink streaming with encrypted TMDB ID support for movies and TV shows
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: Castle
scrapers.description: Multi Lang provider
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: HDHub4u
scrapers.description: Relays an external HDHub4u Stremio addon instead of scraping the site directly - see providers/external-addon.js.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: PenguPlay
scrapers.description: Relays the PenguPlay Stremio addon, itself a multi-source aggregator (4KHDHub, MovieBox, VegaMovies, HDHub4u, VidLink, VidFast, 2Peckle and others) - see providers/external-addon.js.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: KickassAnime
scrapers.description: KickassAnime multi-server anime streaming (sub/dub)
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: VidFastPro
scrapers.description: Multi-server streaming (including a 4K server) via vidfast.vc, ported from the open-source CineStream CloudStream extension. TMDB-id based, no title search involved. Re-enabled 2026-09-20: re-tested the previously-suspected wrong-episode bug live (Breaking Bad S1E1 vs S1E2 - distinct tokens/URLs returned for each, not the same content twice); re-disable if it recurs.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: AllMovieLand
scrapers.description: Multi-language streaming via allmovieland, ported from the open-source CineStream CloudStream extension. Verified end-to-end.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: AnimeWorld
scrapers.description: Italian-subbed anime via AnimeWorld's own session/CSRF-protected episode API (GET /api/episode/info?id=... with a CSRF-Token header) - resolves to a direct, self-hosted SweetPixel CDN link, confirmed live with a real 206 Partial Content and no Cloudflare in front of the video host. No TMDB-season concept on the site itself, so only season 1 (or a movie) is handled precisely; a later season falls back to a best-effort search query.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: Cinejoy
scrapers.description: Multi-server streaming (Lisbon, Nebula, Solara, Athens - fetched live, the set changes) via Cinejoy's encrypted API, resolved through the same public enc-dec.app helper the CloudStream StreamPlay plugin itself relies on for the ECDH/AES-GCM handshake.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: Filmyfiy
scrapers.description: FilmyFly (Filmyfiy's current live brand/domain) - Hindi/English dual-audio Hollywood/Bollywood movie downloads. Resolves through a linkmake.in link-protector to per-quality direct 10Gbps and HubCloud links (movies only, no TV).
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: MoviesDrive
scrapers.description: Indian movie/TV WordPress-style blog with a Typesense JSON search API. Download links route through mdrive.lol to HubCloud, resolved via this repo's shared HubCloud extractor.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: HdMovie2
scrapers.description: Hindi/Bollywood-focused movie and TV blog, self-hosted JWPlayer streams - no download-host intermediary, resolves directly to signed HLS playlists.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: MoviesMod
scrapers.description: Indian movie/TV blog resolving through modpro.blog ad-gates to driveseed.org, landing on direct googleusercontent.com streams. Some quality groups route through a since-repurposed gateway domain and are filtered out live rather than guessed at.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: VegaMovies
scrapers.description: Direct links via VegaMovies' G-Direct resolver (ported from the open-source CloudStream extension). Its original primary resolver, V-Cloud, is now behind a real Cloudflare challenge and unusable here; this uses the same download page's G-Direct option instead, which isn't protected - verified end-to-end.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: RogMovies
scrapers.description: Indian movie/TV blog sharing VegaMovies' own backend (Typesense search, same release naming). Resolves G-Direct links through a nexdrive.fit hub to a direct googleusercontent.com stream.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: NovaStream
scrapers.description: Relays the NovaStream Stremio addon (HLS streams it proxies itself, mostly 720p/1080p) - see providers/external-addon.js.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: DesiFlix
scrapers.description: Relays the DesiFlix Stremio addon: direct 480p-1080p files, strong on Indian films and web series but also carries English titles - see providers/external-addon.js.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: CNCVerse
scrapers.description: Relays the CNCVerse Bridge Stremio addon (CloudStream plugins served as an addon: Netflix/Hotstar/Prime mirrors, HDHub4u, Castle and more). Slow on series - see providers/external-addon.js.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: yastream
scrapers.description: Relays the yastream Stremio addon (KissKH and other Asian-drama sources); also finds many western titles - see providers/external-addon.js.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: VaPlayer
scrapers.description: VaPlayer (nextgencloudfabric.com) data API: ready-to-play HLS master playlists by IMDb id, usually 1080p, for films and series. Fast (~1s) - see providers/vaplayer.js.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team

scrapers.name: Kurage
scrapers.description: Kurage (kurage.live) anime: Japanese audio with English subs and the English dub where available, as direct MP4s. TMDB is mapped to AniList through arm.haglund.dev - see providers/kurage.js.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
